requirements.description: Review input/output/control voltages, capacitor effective values, CT/QOD selection, reverse current and thermal limits.
Review operating/inrush current and actual power/ground conductor capacity.
Compare managed footprint land pattern and local bypass/power paths with DBV package and Figure 32.
Check inrush and discharge with actual supply impedance and load capacitance.
Measure switched rail rise/fall, reset/off behavior, parasitic powering through signals and temperature.
